title: Butterfly Chandelier Dream
description: Surreal scene of four translucent children blowing bubbles in a decaying classical interior that opens into an infinite corridor with a distant figure. A large ornate chandelier made of colorful glowing butterflies and dripping crystals hangs above them, set within a shattered mirror frame with gold leaf and gem-like fragments.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene inside a decaying classical hall with an infinite corridor stretching into the distance containing a small distant figure. Four translucent glowing children in white are blowing bubbles that float through the air. Above them hangs a large ornate chandelier composed of colorful butterflies with glowing wings and dripping crystals. The entire image is framed by a shattered mirror with gold leaf, gems and dripping details. Twilight forest visible through opening, ethereal atmosphere, intricate details.
